podcast.body: This Elastica song sounded "awfully like" The Stranglers' 1977 song "No More Heroes." The similarity resulted in "a piece of that first Elastica album" being awarded to The Stranglers, described as a case of "well-intentioned theft." "The Stranglers, a British band that was formed in 1974, noticed that the Elastica song waking up sounded awfully like one of their songs from 1977 called No More Heroes."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
